name: com.gameframex.unity.globalconfig
description:
GameFrameX GlobalConfig — Unity global configuration package. Holds and manages global game configuration fetched from remote servers: app and resource version check URLs, the hybridclr AOT metadata list (auto JSON-parsed), host server addresses and free-form content. Ships extensible request/response models (RequestBase with language/platform/channel fields) for app version, asset package version and global info queries; the component itself stays a pure data holder without networking logic. Docs: https://gameframex.doc.alianblank.com

GameFrameX GlobalConfig — Unity 全局配置功能包。存储和管理从远程服务器获取的全局游戏配置：应用与资源版本检测地址、hybridclr AOT 元数据列表（自动 JSON 解析）、主机服务器地址及自由附加内容。内置可继承扩展的请求/响应模型（RequestBase 含语言/平台/渠道字段），覆盖应用版本、资源包版本与全局信息查询；组件本身为纯数据持有者，不含网络逻辑。文档：https://gameframex.doc.alianblank.com
